scenarios.name: orders-refresh-keeps-orders
scenarios.behavior: Opens Orders, then fails the next orders read with HTTP 503 and presses Refresh.
scenarios.expectation: ORD-3 in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md: a failed refresh keeps the orders on screen and says "Could not refresh orders."
scenarios.limits: One HTTP 503 on a refresh of the All list; not other filters, offline mode or first loads.

scenarios.name: orders-ship-updates-row
scenarios.behavior: Opens Orders, selects Packed and presses Mark shipped on the first packed order.
scenarios.expectation: ORD-4 in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md: once the server confirms, the row shows "Shipped" without a reload.
scenarios.limits: A successful update only. Each run ships one of the 3 packed orders, so restart the server after 3 runs.

scenarios.name: orders-filter-latest-wins
scenarios.behavior: Opens Orders and selects Shipped at once, while the unfiltered list is still loading.
scenarios.expectation: ORD-2 in docs/REQUIREMENTS.md: with Shipped selected, the list never shows new or packed orders.
scenarios.limits: The Shipped filter right after Orders opens; not other filter changes.
